name: thinking-block-reasoning-attr
notes: The same thinking row driven by the OTHER event variant — Reasoning (a live streaming delta) rather than Thinking (a completed block) — and through the /reasoning toggle rather than by default. Two render inputs on one renderer is the point: a regression that collapsed Reasoning into Thinking, or that stopped honouring show_reasoning, would pass with only one of these baselined. The variant presses /reasoning a second time to pin the toggle-off state. POST-CUTOVER: the ported chrome renders the reasoning body without operant's 'Thinking:' label prefix; the body assertion remains the content gate.
